title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Beat eggs with grated Parmesan and black pepper.
Drain pasta, mix with pancetta, then remove from heat.
Quickly stir in egg mixture to create a creamy sauce.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and half the spices for 2 hours.
Grill or bake chicken until cooked through.
Sauté onions and garlic until soft.
Add remaining spices and tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes.
Add cream and cooked chicken, simmer 5 more minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Caesar Salad
summary: Fresh romaine lettuce with creamy Caesar dressing, croutons, and Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Blend garlic, anchovies, egg yolk, and lemon juice.
Slowly add olive oil while blending to emulsify.
Top with croutons and shaved Parmesan.
